name: UK Falklands Task Force 1982
description: Operation Corporate, May 1982: the carrier group, 3 Commando Brigade and the RAF's long-range support. Stock DCS units. The AV-8B stands in for the Sea Harrier FRS.1 and Harrier GR.3, the UH-1H for the Sea King and Wessex, the KC-135 MPRS for the Victor, the M113 for the Scorpion and Scimitar, and the LHA-1 for HMS Hermes. The squadrons fly under the UK flag; the faction uses the joint task force country so the LHA-1 can sail as HMS Hermes.
